class.name: HorrorInteractor3D
class.brief_description: Finds and activates objects in front of the player.
class.description: [HorrorInteractor3D] casts a ray along its local negative Z axis and looks for a [HorrorInteractable3D] on the collider or one of its parents. It emits [signal target_changed] when the target or its prompt changes, then calls [method HorrorInteractable3D.interact] when the configured input action is pressed. When an empty project is first opened in the Mina Engine editor, the [code]interact[/code] action is mapped to the physical [code]E[/code] key. Existing projects can add the action in Project Settings or change [member interaction_action].

method.name: get_interaction_action
method.description: Returns the Input Map action used to activate the current target.

method.name: get_interaction_distance
method.description: Returns the length of the interaction ray in meters.

method.name: get_current_prompt
method.description: Returns the current target's prompt, or an empty string if no prompt is provided.

method.name: get_current_target
method.description: Returns the current interactable target, or [code]null[/code] if there is none.

method.name: interact
method.description: Calls [code]interact(self)[/code] on the current target and returns [code]true[/code] if it was called.

method.name: set_interaction_action
method.description: Sets the Input Map action used to activate the current target. An empty name disables automatic input handling.

method.name: set_interaction_distance
method.description: Sets the length of the interaction ray in meters. Values below 0.05 are clamped to 0.05.

members.member: The Input Map action that activates the current target. Set this to an empty name to disable automatic input handling.
The ray length in meters. Values below 0.05 are clamped to 0.05.

signal.name: target_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the current target or its prompt changes.
